_note: A dispatch-scheduler plan entry for Aqawan 1 (robofast_core/dispatch.py; docs/design.md 3.7):
python -m robofast_core.sequencer_service --config sites/minerva/aqawan1.json --plan sites/minerva/dispatch.example.json
or paste it (without _note) as the 'plan' entry of aqawan1.json.
site: Mt. Hopkins (legacy site_mtHopkins.ini). Limits: legacy scheduler.ini (MINALT 21, MAXALT 83,
HORIZON -12, MINMOONSEP 10), which the legacy scheduler read but never applied; MINALT equals
telescope_N.ini HORIZON (21). No hour-angle limits: legacy had none (min_ha/max_ha default to -12/+12 h).
filters: imager_t1.ini and imager_t2.ini [FILTERS] (legacy names; the Alpaca wheel's Names must match).
ports are not listed: no telescope has a port_action yet (instruments.json has the M3 port numbers).
instruments: each instrument name's type (robofast_core/instruments.py): 'spectrograph' is KiwiSpec
(SPECTRUM requests, with extra_params iodine and target_counts); 'imager' is its own type.
state and too_dropbox are relative to this file here; use absolute paths (e.g. under
/var/lib/robofast) in production. A ToO is a JSON request group with a 'too' entry dropped
into too_dropbox (see too.example.json).

seeing._note: Where the seeing comes from (docs/seeing.md): the guiders' live FWHM, median of 30 min; guide 'auto' falls back to the guiding model's seeing.

_note: When to offset guide (robofast_core/guider/recommend.py; docs/offset_guiding.md): guide 'auto'.
CDK700 0.7 m. The FAU has NO fiber hole: a beamsplitter in front of the fiber sends ~2 % of the
light (the DESIGN value) to the FAU, which sees the whole star (on_target 'beamsplitter').
fiber_diameter 2.27 arcsec = the 50 um core at 22 um/arcsec (Swift et al. 2015, JATIS 1, 027002,
sec. III.3); plate_scale 0.265 arcsec/px confirmed from the FAU frames' FITS WCS.
PROVISIONAL, one star (T1, night n20230306, 5 s frames): ~500 e-/s at V 8.93, so 1 e-/s at
V ~15.7 -- an effective throughput of ~0.08 % (beamsplitter included; not the design 2 %).
zero_point here is V-band photons (8.1e9 /s/m^2 at V 0), so throughput 0.0008 with light_fraction
1 (the whole FAU field is behind the beamsplitter) reproduces that measurement. Measured FWHM
1.2-1.7 arcsec (seeing: the fallback when the guiders have nothing recent, docs/seeing.md).
The ZWO ASI174MM runs at gain 0 (legacy zwo.py: ASI_GAIN=0 'for maximum dynamic range'):
read_noise 6 e- and ~3.9 e-/ADU are ZWO DATASHEET ESTIMATES, consistent with the measured
0.9-1.5 ADU frame noise. exposure: the longest guide exposure (FAU frames use 5-15 s);
min_rate 0.1 Hz (a correction at least every 10 s, as the legacy FAU) is PROPOSED. ASSUMED: obscuration.
Thresholds: max_error (arcsec rms), min_snr, min_rate, prefer_annulus (on target preferred).
